facts: stat snapshot binds device, inode, size, mtime_ns and ctime_ns
mapped object is SHA-256 hashed through one O_NOFOLLOW FD and fstat metadata is compared before/after hashing
receipt-tail mapping is resampled and final stat metadata must equal the original observed stat snapshot
scope is explicitly one live process generation; productive persistence/restart/recovery remain separate obligations

grf.observed_anchor: Current attestor includes ctime_ns in both hash-window and receipt-tail metadata equality fences.
grf.generated_reality: An in-place same-inode/same-size mutation might hide from the final metadata fence if an actor restores mtime to its original value.
grf.counter_reality: Even with exact mtime restoration, Linux ctime changes, so the existing stat equality fence still distinguishes the mutation.
grf.falsifier: Mutate a mapped file in place without changing inode or size, restore mtime_ns exactly to baseline, then compare ctime_ns and observed mapped bytes.

unusual_experiment.name: RESTORED_MTIME_SAME_INODE_CONTENT_MUTATION
unusual_experiment.intervention: Create a 4096-byte file of A, map it read-only, overwrite the same inode in place with 4096 bytes of B, fsync, then restore atime/mtime nanoseconds to the exact baseline values.
unusual_experiment.interpretation: The local counterexample changed real mapped content while preserving inode, size and mtime, yet ctime diverged. The current attestor compares ctime_ns, so this specific restored-mtime chameleon is distinguishable by the implemented metadata fence.
limitations: Not executed on the accepted Hostinger target.
Does not prove all filesystems or privileged threat models preserve the same ctime behavior.
Does not exercise Frank, UnifiedDB, SQLite WAL, restart/recovery or productive persistence.
Does not promote the live-process attestor beyond its declared one-process-generation proof scope.

primary_source_alignment.sqlite_upstream: SQLite documents the WAL-reset bug as fixed in 3.51.3 and later; 3.53.4 is on the fixed line. Version suitability alone is not productive Frank runtime/path evidence.

architecture_delta.delta: Retain the current device/inode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns + FD-bound hash + receipt-tail resampling mechanism. Do not add a duplicate restored-mtime fence based on this experiment.
